title: 藏经阁残简 第十七章 满库残籍灵气再进藏经阁残简 第十八章 杂役寻衅轻压锋芒
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
库房木门缓缓合上，隔绝外界动静。
尘埃在透过窗缝的日光里漫天飞舞，呛人的陈旧纸墨与朽竹气味扑面而来，沈砚只是轻轻运转一丝文道灵气护住口鼻，半点不受影响。
放眼望去，库房里立着十几排老旧木架，层层叠叠堆满废弃典籍。断裂玉简、虫蛀竹简、受潮霉变的兽皮书卷杂乱堆叠，边角残缺、字迹模糊，在外人眼里全是毫无用处的破烂，宗门索性锁在此地，一放便是数十年。
可落在沈砚眼中，每一卷残籍都萦绕着深浅不一的金色文道微光，那是古籍内留存的法理道韵，是独属于他的修行养料。
《破妄文章》悄然流转神魂，他一眼便能分辨典籍品级，无需逐卷翻看筛选，省下大把功夫。
“这里藏着这么多被埋没的文脉。”沈砚缓步穿行木架之间，心底暗自感慨。
青云仙宗坐拥偌大藏书阁，却只重光鲜完整的正统典籍，将破损古籍视作累赘，随意封存丢弃，白白浪费无数上古传承。
换作旁人，就算进了这间库房，也读不通残缺道文，得不到半点修行好处。唯独他身怀残简道藏，修复残卷如同吃饭喝水般简单，整片库房，等于专门为他准备的修炼密室。
沈砚不再迟疑，伸手取下离自己最近的一卷开裂玉简。
玉简表面布满蛛网裂痕，记载一门中阶炼体文印，宗门馆藏有完整复刻版本，故而这卷破损原件被丢弃封存。
指尖贴上玉面，淡淡的金光从掌心蔓延而出，顺着裂痕游走填补。原本错乱溃散的道纹重新归位，残缺的字句一点点显现，完整功法直接烙印进沈砚神魂。
浑厚的炼体道韵顺着经脉汇入丹田，滋养圆满无瑕的道基。
仅仅片刻功夫，一卷玉简修复完毕，沈砚随手放在一旁空木案，转身拿下第二卷残籍。
一卷、两卷、三卷……
沈砚穿梭一排排木架，不停拾取、修复、收纳，动作行云流水，全程没有半分停歇。
库房之内金光若隐若现，尽数收敛在他周身，绝不外泄半分，外面就算有人路过库房门口，也察觉不到丝毫异样。
其中不乏意外之喜。
一卷受潮粘连的帛书，记载失传的《聚文阵图》，布下阵法可加速文道灵气滋生，日后修行效率能大幅提升；
一截残破兽皮，是上古凝神符箓的制作手稿，弥补了沈砚神魂手段单一的短板；
还有数套残缺吐纳心法，取长补短之下，他自身的基础吐纳法再度优化，灵气转化速度暴涨一截。

海量道韵源源不断涌入体内，丹田之中灵气翻滚沸腾。
他本就卡在凝气七层巅峰，距离八层只差一层薄膜般的壁垒，此刻无数上古文脉持续冲刷经脉、滋养丹田，那层阻碍正在一点点变薄、松动。
不知过去了多久，库房大半木架的残卷都已经被他修复收录，沈砚停下动作，闭目盘膝坐在库房空地。
体内文道之力全力运转，积攒的磅礴灵气朝着境界壁垒全力冲击。
嗡——
一声轻微道鸣自丹田响起，周身经脉微微震颤。
那层卡在七层巅峰许久的境界壁垒，应声碎裂！
凝气八层初期！
磅礴崭新的灵气扩散四肢百骸，浑身每一寸血肉都被精纯文气浸润，力量、神魂、感知全方位提升。
如今的沈砚，修为已经稳稳踏入凝气八层。
寻常内门弟子到这一境界，至少需要四五年苦修，还要海量灵石、丹药辅助。而他仅仅靠着修复一卷卷宗门弃置的残简，短短数日便接连突破，速度骇人听闻。
更难得的是根基没有半分虚浮，道基圆满无瑕，底蕴远超同阶修士，就算遇上凝气九层的刘松，正面交手他也有十足把握稳压对方一头。
沈砚缓缓睁开双眼，眼底一缕清亮金光一闪而逝，随即迅速收敛，恢复成平淡模样。
他起身收拾木案上修复完毕的典籍，将它们依照原本位置放回木架，维持库房原本杂乱的模样。
他不想留下有人进入库房的痕迹，免得引来刘松盘问，暴露自己的秘密。
所有事情打理妥当，沈砚走到库房门前，侧耳细听外面动静。
藏书阁长廊安静，没有脚步声靠近，想来外出晾晒典籍的杂役还未归来。
他轻轻拉开库门，确认四下无人，闪身走出，反手合上木门，又捡起地上断裂的铜锁碎片揣入袖中，避免留下物证。
重回西侧值守台，沈砚拿起抹布，装作方才只是短暂离开、一直在擦拭书架的模样，心底一片从容。
凝气八层在手，库房残卷的机缘尽数收入囊中，重回下层藏书阁的这份收获，远超预期。

只是他清楚，这仅仅只是开始。
刘松的刁难、陆明远的敌视、潜藏在宗门深处的域外黑气……一桩桩一件件，都还摆在他面前。
如今实力再度提升，他隐忍的底气，也更足了。

content_en:
The wooden door of the warehouse slowly closed, blocking out the outside world.
Dust was flying all over the sky in the sunlight that filtered through the cracks in the window, and the choking smell of old paper, ink, and rotten bamboo hit his face. Shen Yan just gently used a trace of literary aura to protect his mouth and nose, and was not affected at all.
Looking around, there are more than a dozen rows of old wooden shelves standing in the warehouse, filled with discarded books piled on top of each other. Broken jade slips, insect-eaten bamboo slips, damp and mildewed animal skin scrolls were piled up in a haphazard manner, with missing corners and illegible handwriting. In the eyes of outsiders, they were all useless rags. The sect was simply locked here and left there for decades.
But in Shen Yan's eyes, every scrap of the book was shimmering with golden light of different shades of literature. It was the charm of Dharma and Taoism left in the ancient books, and it was his unique cultivation nourishment.
"Pollian Articles" quietly circulated in his mind. He could distinguish the grade of the classics at a glance, without having to read and sift through each volume, saving a lot of time.
"There are so many buried cultural contexts hidden here." Shen Yan walked slowly between the wooden shelves, sighing secretly in his heart.
The Qingyun Immortal Sect has a huge library, but it only pays attention to the glorious and complete orthodox classics. It regards damaged ancient books as a burden and seals them away at will, wasting countless ancient inheritance.
If it were anyone else, even if they entered this warehouse, they would not be able to read the incomplete Taoist text and would not gain any benefit from practicing. He is the only one who possesses the Daozang of the broken scrolls. Repairing the broken scrolls is as easy as eating and drinking. The entire warehouse is like a secret cultivation room specially prepared for him.
Shen Yan no longer hesitated and reached out to take down the cracked jade slip closest to him.
The surface of the jade scroll is covered with spiderweb cracks and records an intermediate body-refining seal. The sect has a complete replica in its collection, so the damaged original was discarded and sealed.
The fingertips were pressed against the jade surface, and a faint golden light spread from the palm, traveling along the cracks to fill them. The originally chaotic and disintegrated Dao patterns were restored to their original positions, the incomplete words appeared bit by bit, and the complete technique was directly imprinted into Shen Yan's soul.
The rich body-refining Dao rhyme flows along the meridians into the Dantian, nourishing the perfect and flawless Dao foundation.
In just a moment, one volume of jade slips was repaired. Shen Yan casually put it aside on the empty wooden case, then turned around and picked up the second volume of scraps.
One volume, two volumes, three volumes...
Shen Yan shuttled through the rows of wooden racks, picking up, repairing, and storing them in a fluid manner, without stopping for a moment throughout the process.
The golden light in the warehouse was looming, all concentrated around him, never leaking out. Even if someone outside passed the door of the warehouse, they would not notice anything strange.
There are many unexpected surprises.
A silk book stuck by moisture records the lost "Juwen Formation Diagram". Laying out the formation can accelerate the growth of literary spiritual energy, and the efficiency of future practice can be greatly improved;
A piece of broken animal skin is the manuscript for making the ancient spirit-concentrating talisman, which makes up for the shortcomings of Shen Yan's single method of divine soul;
There are also several sets of incomplete breathing and breathing methods. After learning from each other's strengths, his own basic breathing method has been optimized again, and the speed of spiritual energy conversion has skyrocketed.
Massive amounts of Taoist charm poured into the body, and the spiritual energy in the Dantian boiled.
He was already stuck at the peak of the seventh level of Qi Condensation, with only a film-like barrier between him and the eighth level. At this moment, countless ancient cultural veins continued to wash away his meridians and nourish his dantian, and that barrier was thinning and loosening little by little.
I don't know how much time has passed, but most of the remaining scrolls on the wooden shelves in the warehouse have been repaired and collected by him. Shen Yan stopped moving, closed his eyes and sat cross-legged in the open space of the warehouse.
The power of literary power in the body is running at full strength, and the majestic spiritual energy accumulated is attacking the realm barrier with all its strength.
Buzz——
A slight sound sounded from Dantian, and the meridians throughout the body trembled slightly.
The realm barrier that had been stuck at the peak of the seventh level for a long time suddenly shattered!
The early stage of the eighth level of Qi Condensation!
The majestic new spiritual energy spreads to all limbs and bones, and every inch of flesh and blood in the body is infiltrated by pure literary energy, and the strength, soul, and perception are all improved.
Today, Shen Yan's cultivation has firmly entered the eighth level of Qi Condensation.
For ordinary inner disciples to reach this level, they need at least four to five years of hard training and a large amount of spiritual stones and elixirs.help. And he just relied on repairing the abandoned scraps of a volume of archives, and he made breakthroughs in just a few days, with an astonishing speed.
What's even more rare is that his foundation is not at all frivolous, his Dao foundation is perfect, and his foundation is far beyond that of monks of the same level. Even if he encounters Liu Song, who is at the ninth level of Qi Condensation, in a head-to-head fight, he is fully confident of holding the opponent down.
Shen Yan slowly opened his eyes, and a ray of clear golden light flashed away in his eyes, then quickly converged and returned to his normal appearance.
He stood up and packed up the restored classics on the wooden desk, placing them back on the wooden shelves in their original positions, maintaining the original messy appearance of the warehouse.
He didn't want to leave traces of someone entering the warehouse, lest Liu Song would interrogate him and expose his secrets.
After everything was taken care of, Shen Yan walked to the warehouse door and listened carefully to what was going on outside.
The corridor of the library is quiet, no footsteps are approaching, and the handyman who wants to go out to dry the classics has not yet returned.
He gently opened the door of the warehouse, made sure that no one was around, walked out, closed the wooden door with his backhand, and picked up the broken copper lock fragments on the ground and put them in his sleeves to avoid leaving any physical evidence.
Returning to the west duty station, Shen Yan picked up the rag and pretended that he had only left briefly and had been wiping the bookshelf, feeling calm in his heart.
With the eighth level of Qi Condensation in hand, all the opportunities for the remaining scrolls in the warehouse are in his pocket. The reward of returning to the lower library is far beyond expectations.
But he knew that this was just the beginning.
Liu Song's difficulties, Lu Mingyuan's hostility, the extraterritorial black energy hidden deep in the sect... one by one, they were all still before him.
Now that his strength has improved again, he has more confidence to endure.
